searchText: Hi, how can I convert `peer.ID` to `node.ID`? Issue is I cant exctract the node.ID from inbound connections so thinking if its possible to convert you can do it for specific types of keys. Trying to calculate geographical distribution of Ethereum validators (rop-8) Beacon sentry usually make outbound connections but if you also do inbound the number increases check out - https://github.com/chainbound/valtrack
